site: Hawara Pyramid of Amenemhat III and mortuary-complex area, Fayoum, Egypt
primary_modern_control: M.F. Elshazly et al., Archaeological Prospection and Ground Water Hazard Assessment of the Hawara Pyramid, Fayoum, Egypt, Delta Journal of Science 49(2), 2024, pp.39-53.

water_state.historical_change: In 1889 only the lowest chambers beneath the pyramid foundation were reported to contain groundwater; by the 21st century water had penetrated all rooms/tunnel system.
water_state.current_published_statement: The pyramid's internal structures are completely flooded; cited survey state reported water about 3 m below the entrance level.
water_state.hydrogeological_source: 2024 ERT/TEM work attributes major recharge to eastern/northeastern cultivated land with flood irrigation plus leakage from an old water plant/broken pipes.
water_state.measured_water_table: Approx. 1.5 m depth in eastern/northeastern recharge area and about 10 m depth in southwestern discharge area; modeled flow moves southwest toward/under the pyramid.

geophysics.coverage: pyramid, mortuary/labyrinth area, northern necropolis and surrounding cultivated land
anomalies: ERT profile 3 south of pyramid: two high-resistivity closures, each about 6 m wide at roughly 7.5 m depth.
ERT profile 12 south of pyramid: one high-resistivity closure about 4 m wide at roughly 5 m depth.
Authors state such high-resistivity anomalies could indicate voids/cavities/shafts/halls/rooms or other archaeological remains, but require excavation verification.

importance: Hawara is a rare case combining a true pyramid, completely flooded internal substructure, a quantified modern groundwater model, and testable geophysical anomalies in the adjacent mortuary-complex area.
next_gates: Obtain coordinates/geometry of ERT profiles 3 and 12 and overlay them on Petrie plans and modern site map.
Check whether any post-2024 drilling, excavation or repeat 3D ERT/TEM has ground-truthed the closures.
Compare water chemistry and elevation time series to establish whether controlled dewatering is archaeologically safe.
Prioritize non-invasive 3D geophysics before any claim about hidden chambers.
Track the official/academic LABYRINTH conservation project separately from unverified commercial satellite-scan claims.
canonical_formula: FLOODED_PYRAMID -> MEASURED_HYDROLOGY -> REPEATABLE_GEOPHYSICS -> GROUND_TRUTH -> OBJECT/CONTEXT -> INTERPRETATION
canonical_seal: HAWARA HAS REAL WATER AND REAL ANOMALIES; THE ANOMALIES ARE NOT YET ROOMS.
